sec-head.p: Each layer of a production multimodal pipeline, built and tested as its own verifiable stage.

card.p: Building the pipeline that aligns and fuses diverse data sources—text, images, and audio—into a unified representation, ensuring no modality is lost.
Selecting and configuring the right encoder-decoder architecture (e.g., CLIP, Flamingo, GATO) for your specific modality combinations and latency requirements.
Building the retrieval layer: enabling text-to-image, image-to-text, and audio-to-text search with hybrid indexing and re-ranking for maximum relevance.
Configuring the generation layer with multi-modal grounding constraints and confidence thresholds so the system provides accurate, context-aware responses.
Testing model performance across all modalities using benchmarks like VQA, MS-COCO, and custom metrics, with results shared transparently before launch.
Deploying the full multimodal pipeline as a versioned, monitored API integrated with your product or internal tools.
